imagery.name: City of Durham 2025 aerial orthophotos
imagery.pixelCoordinateConvention: x increases east, y increases south, relative to the northwest mosaic corner. Tile requests use /tile/{zoom}/{y}/{x}.

publishedVisitorParking.hours: Daily 8 a.m. to sunset when the Gardens grounds are open
publishedVisitorParking.note: Official street-level count and hours are context only. Neither defines a bay's coordinates, designation, or present availability. The count is not an input to geometry generation.

method: Manual aerial interpretation of visible stripe endpoints. Each adjacent pair in a run defines one approximate bay, with a curb edge and a travel-lane edge. Endpoints are approximate, not surveyed. No positions are assigned across gaps between runs.

modeledBayExclusion.purpose: Suppress lower-confidence surface-lot models inside the visually identifiable curb row, including imagery gaps. This mask is not a mapped parking area or a legal boundary.

excluded: West end and foliage-obscured part of the row before the first mapped run.
Shadowed and vehicle-obscured area between the west-middle and middle runs.
Equipment-obscured gap between the middle and east runs.
Intersection, crosswalk, curb return, driveway/turning areas, opposite curb and internal H Lot rows.
